Name: Your Neighbor Duke
Author: MrHatmann
Description:
This mod requires Content Patcher to work, which can be found here:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915[/url]
 
Includes Sprites and Portraits, including a special Winter skin.
All dialogue and letters should either be replaced with new content, or at the very least the ones that were more fitting are still around.
 
This is just a silly mod I made for friends, feel free to report any issues you have.

Downloads.Description: Let me know if you encounter out-of-order dialogue or unimmersive text.

Manifest.Name: Your Neighbor Duke Nukem
Manifest.Description: Makes Kent into Duke Nukem from Duke Nukem.
